name: Refajah
title: Descendant of King David
summary: Refajah was a descendant of King David through the line of Zerubbabel, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He belonged to the royal lineage that continued after the exile in Babylon. In addition, there are several other individuals named Refajah in the Old Testament, including a leader who helped rebuild the walls of Jerusalem under Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Refajah is listed as the son of Hananiah and a descendant of Zerubbabel in the royal lineage after David.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Zerubbabel
keyEvents.description: Refajah is part of the post-exilic royal lineage recorded in 1 Chronicles, demonstrating God's faithfulness to the promise of an eternal Davidic line.

keyEvents.title: Refajah as a Leader at Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Another Refaja, son of Hur, was leader over half of the district of Jerusalem and helped with the rebuilding of the city wall under Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Refaja of the Simeonites
keyEvents.description: A group led in part by a Refaja from the tribe of Simeon went to the mountains of Seir and struck down the remaining Amalekites.

keyEvents.title: Refaja among the descendants of Issachar
keyEvents.description: A Refaja is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar as one of the prominent descendants.

keyEvents.title: Refaja among the descendants of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: A Refaja is also mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin as one of Saul's descendants who settled in Jerusalem.
